name: acp3/tests
description: Repository of the ACP3 CMS unit test configuration files and various other code quality tools.

scripts-descriptions.test: Executes the PHPUnit test WITHOUT coverage.
scripts-descriptions.test-with-coverage: Executes the PHPUnit test WITH coverage.
scripts-descriptions.lint: Executes PHP-CS-Fixer WITHOUT fixing the code style errors.
scripts-descriptions.php-cs-fixer: Executes PHP-CS-Fixer WITH fixing the code style errors.
scripts-descriptions.qa: Executes PHP-CS-Fixer (WITHOUT fixing the code style errors), PHPStan and PHPUnit in parallel.
scripts-descriptions.husky: Executes PHP-CS-Fixer (WITH fixing the code style errors). Executes PHPStan and PHPUnit after that in parallel.
